what: research-queue-dispatch `land` job fails ~25% of cycles (3 of the last 12 runs on main, 2026-10-11 16:54Z..2026-10-12 05:53Z: 38161538083, 38171810585, 38182207173). Two modes, both in .github/actions/commit-to-main/action.yml stale-branch refresh: (a) the refresh `git merge FETCH_HEAD` aborts with 'Your local changes to the following files would be overwritten by merge: research/queue/RQ-*.yaml' (dirty working tree left by the dispatch/collect step) -> REFRESH_STATE=failed_conflict -> the stamp PR (#17652 still OPEN and 'dirty'; #17618 had to be merged late) never merges and the job dies at the 80-minute wait; (b) run 38171810585 died at the receipt step on 'local changes would be overwritten by checkout' with the same three queue files. MEASURED by reading the land-job logs; 9 of the 12 runs succeeded, so #17174/#16948/#17297 work when the tree is clean. Fix is in the shared composite action (stash or commit the stamp files before the refresh merge), so it is not a one-line lane change.
